A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 48-page MAmmoTH-VL paper, including Appendices A–D. Pages 2–48 match in extracted text and rendered appearance; the first-page article content also matches, with differences confined to the arXiv stamp and PDF metadata.

before.justification: v1 reports original MAmmoTH-VL-8B benchmark results in Tables 2–4, dataset analyses and ablations in Sections 3–5 and Appendix A, and qualitative examples in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original model evaluations, dataset analyses, ablations, and qualitative examples. Their unchanged status does not alter their attribution to this work.

M1.justification: The collection, task-specific rewriting, and self-filtering pipeline in Section 2 is identical. The model architecture and three-stage training procedure in Section 4.1 also remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training-data sources and categories and the same 23 evaluation benchmarks, covering single-image, multi-image, and video tasks. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within Tables 2–4 and the scaling and rewriting comparisons, including the corresponding LLaVA-OneVision, LLaVA-CoT, InternVL2, and Qwen2-VL variants.

E3.justification: Table 1 retains identical sample counts, training budgets, batch sizes, learning rates, and model configurations. Evaluation retains the same benchmark splits, greedy decoding, zero-shot settings, and ablation procedures.

E4.justification: The filtering, mixing-ratio, training-scale, and rewriting-model analyses in Section 5 and Appendix A are unchanged. Appendices C–D retain the same successful and unsuccessful rewriting cases and model-response examples.

E5.justification: The human–model agreement analysis and Cohen’s kappa reporting in Section 3.3 and Table A5 are identical. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results, and qualitative findings match, including the appendices. For example, MAmmoTH-VL-8B retains 67.6 on MathVista in Table 2 and 55.1 on MuirBench in Table 4.

T1.justification: No mathematical definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added, removed, or revised. Equations and worked mathematical examples remain identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about scalable data generation using open models, the 12-million-entry dataset, and improved multimodal reasoning.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including explanations of filtering benefits, declining attribute-recognition performance during scaling, and the multi-image/video data limitation discussed in Sections 4–5.

D1.justification: Training configurations, preprocessing instructions, Appendix B prompts, and project access information are identical. The added hyperlink on the arXiv stamp does not change code or data access information.

R1.justification: The cited works and Section 6 research positioning are identical. No prior-work comparison or novelty relationship is added, removed, or revised.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv identifier/date changes from v1, 6 Dec 2024, to v2, 4 Jun 2025. This is a limited document-identification edit; the paper’s prose, terminology, headings, and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, axes, formatting, and placement are identical throughout the main text and appendices. The updated marginal stamp does not change the article layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility details, and appendix material are unchanged. Updating the arXiv stamp, attaching its hyperlink, and changing PDF metadata neither resolves a substantive deficiency nor harms the paper’s clarity or evidential quality.
